entities.name: Danish Trade Monopoly & Hardship
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The restrictive Danish trade monopoly (1602–1787), the Laki volcanic eruption (1783–1784) killing a quarter of the population and most livestock (the Móðuharðindin — 'Mist Hardships'), and Icelandic cultural survival through manuscript preservation.
